tooltip.wonderrealms.airship.1: Place it on the ground, then fuel it with coal, charcoal or blaze rods.

tooltip.wonderrealms.airship.3: Sneak and use it empty-handed to open the cargo hold.
tooltip.wonderrealms.airship.4: Use dye on it to color the balloon.
tooltip.wonderrealms.airship_cannon.1: Use on your airship to mount it at the bow.
tooltip.wonderrealms.airship_cannon.2: At the helm, press V to fire. Each shot burns some fuel.
tooltip.wonderrealms.airship_cannon.3: Planks patch a hull holed by cannon fire.
tooltip.wonderrealms.dewdrop.1: Only tiny eyes can find these in the grass.
tooltip.wonderrealms.dewdrop.2: Pixel Miners pay well for them.
tooltip.wonderrealms.dragon_armor.1: Use on your tamed dragon to armor it.

tooltip.wonderrealms.dragon_egg.2: that bonds with whoever is closest.
tooltip.wonderrealms.dragon_whistle.1: Calls every dragon of yours within earshot.
tooltip.wonderrealms.dragon_whistle.2: Sneak and use it to tell them to sit and wait.
tooltip.wonderrealms.ender_egg.1: Something stirs inside... perhaps it's hungry for chorus fruit?
tooltip.wonderrealms.gem_pixel.1: Nine of them craft into a whole gem.
tooltip.wonderrealms.growth_draught.1: Brings you back to your full size.
tooltip.wonderrealms.pixel_chisel.1: Hold it to carve blocks pixel by pixel,
